name: Echo Fragments: Artificer's Wand generates an Echo Fragment (#5270)
contract: Artificer's Wand 561284 (and ranks 561354-561357, the rank ladder AscensionTalentReplacementData.h wires to the Unmake replacement at levels 22/32/42/52) reads 'Generates 1 Echo Fragment' in its own Spell.dbc Description[enUS], mirroring 92120's Wand of Time row. AscensionCustomResourceData.h had ResourceGainRule rows only for 520175/520702-520707 (Wand of Time); no row covered 561284/561354-561357 at all, so casting Artificer's Wand never granted 804455. Unlike Wand of Time, Artificer's Wand does not deal damage on its own cast: Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (227), pulsing the real damaging spell 561064 twice via Unit::CastSpell(..., TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK, ...), and both Spell::IsTriggered() checks in AscensionCompat's OnSpellCast/OnSpellHitResult reject triggered casts. A hit-gated rule on 561064 would therefore never fire, so the new rows use ResourceGainEvent::Cast on the outer cast id (561284/561354-561357) instead of EachSuccessfulDamagingHit, gated on knowing 92120 exactly like the Wand of Time rows.
